title: Streetscape in Monochrome
content: Here's a fun color experiment: dull-reddish orange over a lime green underpainting. Very weird combination, a bit unlike anything I've tried before. (Link to YouTube)I wanted to keep the shadow values up around 50% to get that look of an old photo.
